name: "OpenAI-compatible" is negotiated, not assumed
prose: optional body fields are where servers differ. A 400 naming `stream_options`, `max_tokens` (OpenAI's reasoning models want `max_completion_tokens`) or `num_ctx` drops or renames that field and re-sends once, then remembers for the life of the provider. Cost of an unfamiliar API: one extra request, once — instead of a dead turn. Nothing that changes what the model can do is negotiable (`tools` is never dropped).
invariant: A 400 naming stream_options, max_tokens or num_ctx drops or renames that field and re-sends once, then remembers; tools is never dropped.
